items.title: Egyptian president calls Iran, US to resolve conflict

items.title: Editorial: Somalia's Security Dilemma: Can a Nation Dependent on Foreign Forces Defend Itself?
items.description: For years, international partners have helped Somalia fight Al-Shabaab, train troops and strengthen its security institutions. items.titleIt: Editorial: Somalia's Security Dilemma: Can a Nation Dependent on Foreign Forces Defend Itself?

items.title: Biggest ever Fayum portrait show at Ara Pacis until May
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 03 NOV - The biggest ever show in Italy of ancient Roman-Egyptian Fayum mummy portraits is set to wow visitors at Rome's Ara Pacis museum from November 5 to May 2 next year. items.title: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia
items.description: The closure of the U.N. Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) follows a two-year transition agreed with the federal government. Its responsibilities have been transferred to Somali institutions and U.N. agencies. The mission's roots dates back to 1995, when the U.N. established its Political Office for Somalia. It was replaced by the U.N. Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) in 2013 before entering its final transition phase as UNTMIS in 2024. items.titleIt: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia

items.title: Somali forces report heavy fighting near Burhakaba as airstrike claims denied
items.description: Multiple sources reported fierce clashes in the area, with initial accounts indicating significant losses among federal government forces. Separate reports from Leego said several senior military commanders were missing. The number of casualties and the status of the missing commanders remained unclear. Al-Shabab also released photographs purporting to show Somali military vehicles burned during the fighting. The images could not be independently verified. However, the Somali federal government rejected reports that Turkish F-16 fighter jets or armed drones struck Somali National Army position
items.titleIt: Somali forces report heavy fighting near Burhakaba as airstrike claims denied

items.title: Somalia Opposition leaders reject 2027 election timetable
items.description: Former president Shariif Sheikh Ahmed criticized the incumbent president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of seeking to retain power unlawfully. items.titleIt: Somalia Opposition leaders reject 2027 election timetable
